question.en: Discuss the role of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) in promoting sustainable shipping practices globally.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) in promoting sustainable shipping practices globally.

modelAnswer.en: The IMO plays a critical role by setting international standards for ship design, construction, and operation. Key contributions include the MARPOL convention for pollution control, regulations for reducing greenhouse gas emissions from ships, and technical assistance to developing nations to adopt green maritime technologies.
